newsitem.title: USA: National Fuel seeks interchange interest.
newsitem.headline: National Fuel seeks interchange interest.

text.p: National Fuel Gas Co said Tuesday an open season will begin September 10 for a project which would increase existing capacity to transport natural gas from the Canadian border at Niagara, N.Y., to Leidy, Pa.
Niagara is an existing interconnect between the National Fuel system and TransCanada PipeLines Ltd.

During September, TransCanada is conducting an open season for its Nexus 98 expansion project, which will increase the capacity of the TransCanada system to deliver additional Canadian gas supplies commencing in 1998 or 1999.

National Fuel said it is holding this open season to allow customers to coordinate requests with TransCanada and National Fuel to create a continuous transportation path from the producing regions in western Canada to the expanding market center located at Leidy.

Facility designs have been developed to expand the National Fuel system to provide transportation capacity for an additional 250 million cubic feet per day. If this open season indicated sufficient customer interest, this flexible project could be modified to accommodate customer requests of up to 500 million cubic feet daily, the company said.

The open season period will extend until 1700 EDT/2100 GMT October 9. During this period, requests will be accepted for transportation services commencing on November 1, 1998, or November 1, 1999, which directly corresponds with the anticipated commencement of expansion services by TransCanada.
